description: Integrated configuration: every option on at once in the shared MCP server. Identity derived from the MCP session (bearer token), clearing after each hooked call, send binding, datagram hooks, trusted-runtime mode, egress policy (classes as in E6), and live factd exporting IPFIX; collector fact-all.bt (bytes and UDP flows). Each tool call sends a DNS query with dnspython (UDP), an HTTP GET with httpx, and a subprocess connect, all to its exclusive port. Same reference (destination port -> execution) for every flow and decision.
